messages.author: 399bf2e734c020dc
messages.subject: INLA testing version error
parts:
Hi I have tried to install the inla testing version using  "install.packages("INLA", repos="https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/testing")" so that I can use the strategy  "inla.mode="experimental" to save memory however I am encountering an error when I try to run inla,

here is my model

m1 <- response ~ -1 -1 + intercept + intercept11 + sand_per + silt_per + sand_per11 + silt_per11

fit.sa<- inla(m1,
              family=c('binomial', 'gamma'),
              data=inla.stack.data(stk.zy2),
              control.compute=list(dic=TRUE, waic = TRUE),
              control.predictor=list(A=inla.stack.A(stk.zy2), compute=TRUE, link=1),
              control.inla=list(int.strategy="eb"), verbose = T,
              control.fixed = list(prec.intercept = 0.001),
              inla.mode="experimental")

and here is the error 

inla_build: check for unused entries in[C:\Users\xxxxxxxxx\AppData\Local\Temp\RtmpyM4ePx\file32bc5a2a142a/Model.ini]


Unused entry [INLA.Parameters!bfgs.version]=[3]


inla_build: [C:\Users\xxxxxxxxx\AppData\Local\Temp\RtmpyM4ePx\file32bc5a2a142a/Model.ini] contain[1] unused entries. PLEASE CHECK

thank you for any help,

Sylvan
